dublinCore.description: Interactive visualization of the course learning graph showing concept dependencies, with taxonomy filtering, type-ahead search and live node, edge and orphan statistics.

learningObjectives: Identify the prerequisites of a concept by tracing the arrows that point into its node
Use the legend checkboxes to isolate one category and predict the node, edge and orphan counts before reading them from the statistics
Explain why the orphan count rises when a category is hidden, even though the full graph has no orphans
Locate a concept with the search box and state which category it belongs to
Evaluate a study sequence by deciding which categories must be shown together so that no visible concept is missing a prerequisite

misconceptions.misconception: An arrow points from a concept to the things it needs
misconceptions.correction: Arrows point from a prerequisite to the concept that depends on it
misconceptions.evidence: Search for Real Numbers: it has no arrow pointing in and 13 arrows leaving it

misconceptions.misconception: Orphans are the concepts that nothing else depends on
misconceptions.correction: In this viewer an orphan is a visible node with no visible edge in either direction; the full graph has 0 orphans although 112 concepts have no dependents
misconceptions.evidence: Check only System Properties: the statistics report 14 orphans; also check Signal Fundamentals and the count returns to 0

accessibility.screenReaderScript: Interactive network diagram of the course learning graph. Each node is a concept and each arrow points from a prerequisite to a concept that depends on it. Use the legend checkboxes to show or hide a category and the search box to find a concept by name.

model.description: Filters a directed graph by node attribute and recomputes the visible node count, the visible edge count (both endpoints visible) and the orphan count (visible nodes with no visible edge)
algorithms: substring search over visible node labels
